audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer repeatedly names Hwei's key ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' — this ability does not exist in Hwei's kit (P/Q/W/E/R are Signature of the Visionary, Subject: Disaster, Subject: Serenity, Subject: Torment, Spiraling Despair). It appears in winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, report[1], report[5], report[9].
audit.why: enemyKit confirms E = Subject: Torment carries hardCC and slow flags ('crowd control abilities'), matching the described behaviour ('All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint'). The fabricated name is the same class of error as Brand's 'Ares of Blaze' in the calibration set.
audit.corrected: Replace every instance of 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' with 'Subject: Torment (E)', the real ability the description is about.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart marks Level 6 and 2+ items as 'Skill' (phases[4].side, phases[6].side) while the content layer's win[4] and win[6] both say 'Swain', and phases[4].why/phases[6].why themselves describe a Swain advantage ('Demonic Ascension online... invite them', 'Late support Swain anchors').
audit.why: The why text and the content win[] already agree Swain wins those two rows; only phases[].side was left on the generic 'Skill' template value, contradicting its own why sentence and the mirrored content field.
audit.corrected: Move phases[4].side and phases[6].side to 'Swain' to match win[4]/win[6] and the existing why text (win[] already correct, no content edit needed per the chart rule).

audit.why: Spikes correctly key to the Lvl2 all-in wash, the Lvl6 Demonic Ascension flip, and the roughly-even 1st-item burst trade.

edits.before: Survive the poke and drain its conclusion. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.
edits.after: Survive the poke and drain its conclusion. Track Subject: Torment (E) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and billing your duo per wave until the all-in is unaffordable.
edits.after: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Torment (E), denying your pattern, and billing your duo per wave until the all-in is unaffordable.

edits.before: - Swain vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Hold the root for the window that matters — one binding decides bot. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.
edits.after: - Swain vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (E). - Hold the root for the window that matters — one binding decides bot. - Engage only on Subject: Torment (E)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Nevermove answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Hwei's Subject: Torment (E) is down 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — all his CC lives there; dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Nevermove (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

edits.before: If Hwei’s duo gets a kill, respect Subject: Fear (CC Paints) and reset to vision work. Two kills: peel only — peel only and rebuild through vision and root discipline.
edits.after: If Hwei’s duo gets a kill, respect Subject: Torment (E) and reset to vision work. Two kills: peel only — peel only and rebuild through vision and root discipline.

edits.before: E the carrier, pull the fragment, Q the formation — one root taxed three bars and healed yours.
edits.after: Subject: Serenity (W) is Hwei's only shield — force him to burn it on a poke trade before you commit your all-in, or he blocks your burst for free.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 at marksman range — the demon era has a start date; respect it.
edits.after: Your R commits you to melee range — popping it while Hwei can still safely paint from max range just feeds him a free combo instead of forcing a fight.

edits.before: Survive the poke and drain its conclusion. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.
edits.after: Survive the poke and drain its conclusion. Track Subject: Torment (E) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.

edits.before: Track Hwei’s Subject: Fear (CC Paints): All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Hwei’s Subject: Torment (E): All his CC lives here — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. It’s down or you don’t go.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment (E)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. His answer goes first; yours goes last.

notes: Major fix: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' is a fabricated Hwei ability name (his real kit is Subject: Disaster/Serenity/Torment for Q/W/E) — replaced with the real Subject: Torment (E), which matches the hardCC/slow flags actually on E. Fixed the level-chart/content disagreement at Level 6 and 2+ items (full said Skill, content win[] already said Swain, and the why text already argued Swain — moved side only, per the chart rule, no win[] edit needed). Fixed both COPY_PASTE_BLEED lint hits and added real cooldown digits to breakdown.cooldowns. Left the content-layer sub-spell combo names (QQ Devastating Fire, EW Crushing Maelstrom, QE Pool of Reflection, EQ Grim Visage) unverified — the brief's kit only gives per-slot P/Q/W/E data, not Hwei's Q+W+E combo-cast mapping, so I could not confirm or deny those against source data; flagging for a pass with full Hwei kit detail if available.
